scope: Persist the existing dev-workflow cache override and commit the four existing scoped repository changes; no candidate content changes.
reason: Preserve scoped Skill invocation, existing authorization, proportionate review/testing and stopping criteria across plugin cache replacement.

upstream.upstream_revision_note: Not established in local plugin metadata; no upstream download performed. Canonical source hash identifies the baseline.

canonical_contract.conversion: Decode UTF-8, remove leading BOM if present, replace CRLF with LF; reject bare CR. Preserve final newline, all other whitespace and Unicode code points.
canonical_contract.precondition: Exact original canonical SHA-256 match before apply
canonical_contract.postcondition: Exact patched canonical SHA-256 match after apply
canonical_contract.raw_hash_role: Environment-specific secondary verification only; never the canonical drift key.

patch.source: Existing deterministic patch from failed closeout, unchanged byte for byte.
patch.hash_semantics: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 LF patch bytes. Canonicalize a checkout copy using the same BOM/CRLF procedure before hash verification; never alter hunks.

apply.stderr:
Checking patch skills/review-driven-development/SKILL.md...
Applied patch skills/review-driven-development/SKILL.md cleanly.

validation_reused.owner_hard_gate_diff_review: Prior review preserved; no candidate modification this recovery

drift_detection: Resolve plugin identity and stable relative path, then compare canonical source SHA-256. Patched canonical hash means already applied. Unknown canonical hash, identity mismatch or offset/fuzzy application means STOP/BLOCKED; never rebaseline automatically.
completion_boundary: After the single scoped local commit, STOP at LOCAL_ENGINEERING_CHECKPOINT_READY. No remote delivery, push, merge, promotion, runtime or execution authorization.
other_personal_skills: This durable override patch covers dev-workflow only. User-local design/redesign files remain in their existing locations; they are not silently copied into this repository.
